title: The Core From Here
hook: The Core sits ahead. Someone new is on the radio.
scene: Clear cold night, the Ledger on a legal pad at the north end of Central. Downtown is a dark geometry with a few stubborn lamps — the Core, locked from here. Mya has finally moved off the glass. The radio, which has been trash for two acts, carries a young voice — a count-in, then a laugh, then static. Yuna, not yet a face. The door to Act IV is visible and shut. The log has a line left for tomorrow.
debrief: The skyline is dark and the sign is dark with it. The next driver is already talking. The door is locked on purpose.

source.teaching_target: Cliffhanger: the Core is visible, Act IV is locked, Yuna is teased on the radio.
